recipes.name: Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients_raw: 1 (17.5 fluid ounce) bottle Buffalo wing sauce, divided
0.5 (1 ounce) package dry ranch salad dressing mix

steps.text: Place chicken breasts into the slow cooker; pour in 3/4 of the wing sauce and ranch dressing mix.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 to 7 hours.
Shred chicken in the cooker with two forks. Stir in butter.
Pile shredded chicken and sauce onto hoagie rolls. Serve with remaining Buffalo sauce.

raw_recipe.headline: Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken Sandwiches
raw_recipe.description: This crockpot Buffalo chicken recipe is super easy to prepare. Perfect for spicy sandwiches that will please anyone who loves Buffalo chicken wings!

review.reviewBody: Okay, let me say that I don't think just giving this 5 stars will express how much my fiance loved these sandwiches. Direct quotes from him: "This is the best thing to ever come out of a crockpot in the history of cooking", "I would eat my way out of a bathtub of this". LOL! Seriously, if we weren't already engaged, this stuff would have made him propose on the spot. :) The only change I made was to shred the chicken after 5 hours and then put it back into the crockpot to let it soak up all the sauce for another 2 hours. I served the meat on toasted Kaiser rolls with melted pepperjack cheese. Thank you very much, needless to say this will be a VERY regularly made recipe in our house! :)

I wanted to try this recipe, and I didn't have time to go get "the buffalo wing sauce", so I made a mix of Frank's hot sauce and melted butter. Great flavor, and I liked alot, but it was too spicy for my family. Also, I got home late from work, and it cooked 9 hours instead of 7-8. Totally my fault, of course,and the chicken was overcooked (getting mushy), so I will only make again, only when I can time it correctly. Still was very good with my (couldn't-help-it-this-time)changes. Now, I can't wait to try exactly! Thanks, "crazycatlady", from the "Recipe Exchange", for suggesting, and Divinesoalc21 for an easy,why-didn't-I-think-of-that, delicious recipe!

As a Buffalo chicken fan I have to say this recipe is incredible. Being that I am trying to watch what I am eating makes it even better because you get all the flavor without frying and all the fatty skin. Also this is not only good on sandwiches but also as soft taco meat, on wraps, and in salads. I also used it with some brown rice and vegetables. I took a lot of the tips from previous reviewers and struck upon the perfect combination to solve any of the problems from people who gave it bad reviews. This is what I did: In place of 4 boneless breasts I used 3 very large bone-in breasts. Instead of the ranch dressing packets I made my own ranch seasoning. I did not add any salt to the ranch dressing seasing I made, just used the herbs and spices (There is enough salt in the hot sauce). After 5 hours, I deboned the chicken and shredded it slightly and put it back in the sauce. This keeps it perfectly moist and tender. Rather than butter I spinkled it a bit with "Molly McButter". I like it really hot and using that just toned it down ever so slightly. I used Franks "Red Hot" Buffalo sauce and it was in no way too hot for me. For the others complaining it was too hot use a milder sauce or add more butter. That will tone it down. Also I think by making your own Ranch Seasoning any problems with it being too salty will be eliminated, just remember not to add salt to your homemade ranch dressing seasoning recipe if it calls for it.

I absolutely love buffalo chicken wings. I decided to halve this recipe as it’s only two of us. Instead of using our slow cooker, I decided to cook chicken in my Instant Pot for an hour & 15 mins. I used Franks but realized the 2 bottles I had were different labels. Aghast!! One was wing sauce the other Hot sauce. I had already poured the hot sauce when I realized the difference. So note to self for future reference. I then added the equal amount of Wing sauce. I couldn’t wait to try it, it came out so tender & minimal shredding was needed. I found it to be very spicy for my taste & a bit salty but that could have been my fault due to the Hot sauce confusion. I will update when I use the correct sauce in future. Thank you for an easy meal!

Turned out great. Served on toasted hoagie buns topped with blue cheese and pickles, put under the broiler for a couple min to soften/slightly brown the blue cheese. Didn’t use quite the whole bottle of Franks. Leftovers were a little salty the next day so good thing I didn’t. Either way, a super easy and fun sandwich for weeknight meals or potlucks! Thanks Divinesolace21!

It was the best pulled chicken sandwich.i made this in my Instant Pot, it was done in less then 30 minutes also I used chicken thighs which is much better then breast. I pull on Hawaiian little rolls with homemade cole slaw and avocado. I forgot to take a photo as we were starving. Next time I will do this with pork shoulder.

Very simple very delicious,and I don’t like chicken,that being said Im not one to follow recipe’s to exact but same concept,I used several thigh’s several Brest tenderloins 2-3 tbs of butter pack of the dry ranch dressing mix and a 12oz bottle of Parmesan garlic wing sauce,cook for 5 hrs shredded it up cut up a red onion left them in rings for about 30 mins just to tinder up…added the onion a honey vinegar base slaw and blue cheese crumbles to a homemade sweet hoagie bun..

Good. Made in the Instant Pot instead of the crockpot. Also toasted the bun in the oven (with cheese) before hand then added the chicken and baked 5 minutes more. Added ranch to top it off. You could really do this with any chicken wing sauce combo.

This was delish and not to mention super easy, as it only dirtied a few items! I added homemade garlic butter on each side and broiled the hoagies in the oven in low. I also added provolone cheese and chopped romaine lettuce.

This was easy and delicious! For my picky family it was a big win for me. They all loved it and asked for seconds even wanted thirds. I used SWEET BABY RAY'S BUFFALO WING SAUCE, and it still had a kick to it, but it was more like a child kick verses an adult kick lol Thanks for sharing!

Tender, juicy, scrumptious chicken. I didn't add the butter.
Served over lettuce, tomato and shredded cheese salad. drizzled some of the sauce it cooked in over the shredded chicken. Wonderful!

Okay. This was a tough one. I really like the IDEA of buffalo chicken. I like buffalo wings, i like buffalo sauce for fries or chicken nuggets if I'm eating at the golden arches. This was a little one-note. BUT!! I think that's a me issue, not a recipe issue. The recipe is easy, no fuss, and pretty inexpensive. I think I just picked wrong for my own tastes. So. If you, unlike me, have the critical thinking and reading comprehension to uinderstand that this recipe, buffalo sauce and chicken, will taste like just buffalo sauce and chicken, and you actually really like those things? frickin go for it! It's great. For me? ehhh probly not again 3.5 stars (i'd give it 2 for taste but again, that's my own personal preference, not the recipes fault)
This is my first time trying buffalo sauce. Perhaps I used the wrong brand of buffalo sauce, as it became extremely salty after being heated. I followed the recipe exactly.

The addition of butter tips this from a basic dump and cook to something a little bit richer tasting. It still is super simple but I wouldn’t have thought of that myself. Usually I use frozen breaded buffalo chicken strips and that’s okay. Just more expensive per pound. I just wish I had a larger slow cooker so I could make more for leftovers!
Unfortunately no one in my family liked this recipe. I followed the recipe and I used Sweet Baby Ray's buffalo sauce.
I think I’m going to try this with boneless, skinless chicken thighs. Better flavor and very hard to overcook.
